spanish: y oiga su varón en día de su oír, y calle a ella, y se levantarán sus votos, y sus ataduras que ató sobre su alma se levantarán.

findings.issue: oiga is present subjunctive/jussive (let him hear). The token is qal sequential perfect 3ms, so the Spanish changes the verbal force.
calle a ella is subjunctive and makes her the one silenced. The verb is hiphil sequential perfect 3ms (he keeps silent) and לָהּ is only the preposition to her.

notes: The other tokens match in participants, number, and lexicon, including both קום clauses.
